about: Trade intel the opposing GMs use: who is on the block, what each club is looking for, who is shedding salary, and each club's posture. status: available = shopping him or clearly available; listening = open to offers (price high = they want an overpay); untouchable = ONLY for an entry the owner wrote (owner: true) or a player with a full no-trade clause (ntc: true). A club saying publicly that a player is not available is NOT untouchable: record it as listening with price high and "denied": true (owner, 11/24: clubs say things they do not mean). dump = the club is reported to want out of the contract or to move a problem player (the trade engine then treats the deal as a salary dump); ntc = full no-trade clause. Team 'win' overrides the window when reporting shows the baseline is wrong. Master copy lives in the public repo; the daily task refreshes it. OWNER NOTES: an entry with "owner": true is the owner's own read of a situation. Never change its status, note or src, and never remove it, because of public reporting or a club's public comments (clubs say things they do not mean). Only a completed move (he is traded, signed elsewhere or retires) takes it off. If new reporting disagrees with an owner entry, leave the entry alone and mention the disagreement in your summary. An entry may carry "until": "YYYY-MM-DD"; it stops applying after that date, and a task may remove it then.

LAD.note: Tax payroll near $385M; never made Skubal a formal offer (Gonzalez, ESPN) and not inclined to chase starters (Woo, The Athletic). Added Royce Lewis; RHP Ben Casparius (Tommy John, Nov. 25) joins Halvorsen out for 2027 (AP); bullpen and getting younger remain the needs.

NYY.note: Bullpen is Cashman's top priority: added Loáisiga and LHP Brent Suter; weighing a big Morejón deal vs. spreading money over a reliever, Carson Kelly and Tyrone Taylor (Sherman, NY Post); Taylor has since signed with the White Sox (11/24). Also bid big on Skubal (Nightengale). Also among six clubs interested in Brandon Lowe (Morosi, MLB Network, 11/24). Among five clubs (Mets, Yankees, Cubs, Blue Jays, Rays) interested in ex-NPB 1B Tyler Austin, likely on a minor league deal (Sherman, NY Post, 11/24). Still in on LHP Adrian Morejón (Heyman, NY Post, 11/24), though MLBTR calls them a long shot after the Loáisiga, Bednar, Hill and Suter adds. Have shown interest in FA LHP Alex Vesia and want a right-handed-hitting catcher to pair with Austin Wells; Carson Kelly the top option (Kuty/Sammon, The Athletic, 11/26).

SEA.note: After a 76-86 year, traded Bryce Miller, Ferrer and Evans to KC for Maikel Garcia; about $30-35M to spend. Seiya Suzuki is the top priority and expected to sign before the lockout; met with FA relievers Vesia, Abreu and Gregory Soto (wants a lefty), not in on Morejón (Adam Jude, Seattle Times, 11/25). Dipoto: 'zero' chance of trading another starter.

BOS.note: All in; still needs a starter (lost Gil to Detroit) and more power, and shortstop remains a need. The outfield logjam has Duran and Yoshida on the market (Cotillo/McAdam, MassLive).

MIL.note: Defending World Series champion keeping its core; needs right-handed relief, a left-handed first baseman if Bauers leaves, and a backup catcher.

CLE.note: Lost the ALCS in six; Antonetti said payroll will rise and a starter was a primary goal; signed Kris Bubic (1 yr, $17.5M, Passan, ESPN, 11/24); added LHP Foster Griffin (3 yr, $48M, Murray, FanSided, 11/25).

TBR.note: Won the pennant, lost the World Series; the rotation is the big question with Peralta and Martinez free agents. Some payroll flexibility under the new owner. One of six clubs interested in 2B Brandon Lowe (Morosi, MLB Network, 11/24). Among five clubs (Mets, Yankees, Cubs, Blue Jays, Rays) interested in ex-NPB 1B Tyler Austin, likely on a minor league deal (Sherman, NY Post, 11/24).

MIN.note: Buying after 77-85 (Gray signed, Jeffers took the QO); added RHP Kevin Ginkel (2 yr, $18M; Feinsand, MLB.com, 11/25); still wants a left-handed reliever and a right-side infielder, 1B/2B (Hayes, The Athletic).

TOR.note: Signed NPB RHP Kaima Taira (5 yr, $80M, Heyman, 11/24); OF and DH are the top needs (a right-handed OF fits; fewest HR in MLB), one of the 'big three' on Arozarena and Suzuki (Morosi, MLB Network, 11/25). Still shopping starters: King, Mahle, Holmes, N. Martinez on the radar (Nicholson-Smith, Sportsnet, 11/25). In on Morejón (Morosi); on Lowe and Tyler Austin.

DET.note: Competing around a young core; signed Pagán (closer), extended Melton, added Luis Gil and INF Ha-Seong Kim (1 yr, $5M, Passan, ESPN, 11/24) and RHP Kevin Gausman (1 yr, $25M, Passan, ESPN, 11/25); wants more right-handed relievers (Stavenhagen, The Athletic); interested in RHP Bryan Abreu but stuck on length, Abreu wants multi-year, DET prefers one year (Evan Petzold, Free Press, 11/24).

PHI.note: Dombrowski must add an outfielder (wants a right-handed bat) and a top setup man; 3B is open. One of the 'big three' on Arozarena and Suzuki (Morosi, MLB Network, 11/25). About $280M in tax commitments limits him. On 2B Brandon Lowe (Morosi, 11/24); not serious on Morejón (Gelb/Varnes, The Athletic).

ATL.note: Won the NL East and returns its core; starting pitching is the clear top need, then shortstop, left field and the bullpen.

PIT.note: First winning season since 2018; Cherington says the club is not financially constrained and will attack free agency and trades.

CHC.note: Signed Trevor Rogers (5 yr, $120M, Rosenthal) and NPB slugger Teruaki Sato (6 yr, $120M, Passan, ESPN, 11/24), who goes to a corner OF spot; still wants a pitching addition or two and relievers (MLBTR, 11/24). Likely to sign one more starter (Clay Holmes and David Peterson in play; door shut on Imanaga), then the bullpen after the CBA expires (Jesse Rogers, ESPN, 11/24). Among five clubs (Mets, Yankees, Cubs, Blue Jays, Rays) interested in ex-NPB 1B Tyler Austin, likely on a minor league deal (Sherman, NY Post, 11/24).

HOU.note: Won the AL West, swept in the Wild Card round; new GM Randy Flores. Owner Jim Crane does not expect a teardown. Thin in the outfield and rotation, with one infielder too many now that Correa is healthy. Rotation is thin behind Hunter Brown; wants at least one starter (Rosenthal, The Athletic; McTaggart, MLB.com).

ATH.note: Young club with its hitters signed long term; the need is pitching: a proven starter and a closer.

BAL.note: Listening on everyone except Pete Alonso. Landed Peralta (5/$125M) and Robert Jr. (1/$12M). Willing to trade infielders (Westburg, Mayo, Encarnacion-Strand, Blaze Alexander) for starters (Rosenthal/Sammon, The Athletic; Sherman, NY Post; 11/26). Eyeing OF Happ, Dubón, Straw; still wants a catcher; on 2B Lowe (Morosi).

TEX.note: Third straight losing season; Chris Young says payroll stays near $190M and he is very open-minded on trades, including stars. Reported to be exploring a way out of part of Corey Seager's contract.

CHW.note: A breakthrough 2026 has Getz talking about improving a contender early in its window; impact starting pitching is the top priority even after signing Dustin May. Signed OF Tyrone Taylor (2 yr, $17M; Heyman, NY Post, 11/24).

ARI.note: Trying to win in 2027, but Hazen says payroll comes down from 2026's franchise record. Wants to move Marte before the lockout to clear payroll; still needs 1-2 starters and a reliever, Alex Vesia on its radar (Nightengale, USA Today). Arenado is working out at first base (Steve Gilbert, MLB.com). Has gotten calls on SPs Eduardo Rodriguez and Merrill Kelly; any Kelly deal likely needs ARI to pay down salary (Rosenthal/Sammon, The Athletic, 11/24).

MIA.note: Bendix wants a starter, a reliever and is open to an everyday corner bat. C filled: Gary Sánchez, 1 yr, $6.5M (Passan, ESPN, 11/25).

KCR.note: Went 69-93 and is aiming for a 2027 rebound around Bobby Witt Jr.; about $30M is coming off the payroll. Wants a right-handed outfielder. Filled 3B with Alec Bohm (2 yrs/$20M; Rosenthal, The Athletic). Added LHP RP Caleb Thielbar (1 yr; Castillo, ESPN).

STL.note: Still rebuilding under Chaim Bloom with a bottom-three payroll; only short-term veterans, rotation and bullpen first. Checked in on SPs Shota Imanaga, Casey Mize and Shane Bieber, no favorite yet; also eyeing left-handed relief such as A.J. Minter (Goold, Post-Dispatch, via MLBTR, 11/25).

WSN.note: Went 77-85; Toboni says pitching is the main need, rotation and late-inning arms. Added LHP A.J. Puk (1 yr, $5M; Passan, ESPN, 11/25). Engaged with free agent 2B Jazz Chisholm Jr., no deal close; their 2B spot had an MLB-worst .577 OPS (Murray, FanSided, 11/24).

SDP.note: Missed on Skubal (offer near $400M with deferrals, Heyman); will 'do everything possible' to re-sign Michael King and wants Pivetta on a new structure, plus a corner OF: Suzuki or Duran (Sato went to the Cubs) (Nightengale, USA Today; Cassavell, MLB.com). Rotation targets Peralta (BAL) and Kaima Taira (TOR) signed elsewhere 11/24. One of six clubs interested in 2B Brandon Lowe (Morosi, MLB Network, 11/24). One of the 'big three' on Arozarena and Suzuki, either could play LF (Morosi, MLB Network, 11/25); Morosi doesn't expect a Morejón return. Agreed with LHP reliever JoJo Romero, 3 yrs/$21M (Passan, ESPN; Rosenthal, The Athletic, 11/25).

SFG.note: Finished 65-97, but Posey says the core can turn it around quickly; wants a starter, a closer and a left-handed reliever. Reported to want out of at least one of its huge contracts (Devers, Adames, Chapman).

LAA.note: Direction undecided: the club is being sold, and no GM or manager will be hired until the sale is approved. Needs a catcher, a center fielder, left-handed bats and bullpen help.

CIN.note: Finished last, but Krall says no rebuild and the aim is to contend in 2027; wants starting pitching, a No. 1 catcher and bullpen help, and is open to trading veterans. Filled catcher by re-signing Tyler Stephenson (3 yr, $30M, Passan, ESPN, 11/24). Still needs a back-end reliever, a rotation upgrade and a multi-position infielder (MLBTR, 11/24); ownership had not set a 2027 budget as of the GM Meetings (Wittenmyer, Cincinnati Enquirer).

COL.note: Won 58 games, 15 better than 2025; DePodesta's priority is starting pitching through trades and established free agents, says investment will be equal or larger and nothing is driven by money. Signed LHP David Peterson (2 yr, $32M; Harding, MLB.com; Murray, FanSided, 11/25); signed LHP Patrick Sandoval (3 yr, $42M; Passan, ESPN, 11/25).

NYM.note: Signed Skubal (9/$450M) and Goldschmidt (1/$8M, 1B platoon with Jared Young); still want relievers, a 1B/DH bat and possibly a starter, now more opportunistically: McLean and Christian Scott are locked in, the last two spots open to Manaea, Senga, Megill, Thornton and Tong (Sammon, The Athletic, 11/26). Want a right-handed bench outfielder, since Soto, Ewing and Benge all hit lefty (Sammon; Rosenthal, The Athletic). Earlier talks with Mahle, Boyd and Imanaga (Sammon, 11/24); interested in Tyler Austin (Sherman, NY Post), Michael King and Jazz Chisholm Jr. (MLB.com, 11/24).
